article_title: The Other Bennet Sister Christmas special teased in new photos

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: New pictures and confirmed details preview a three-part Christmas special of The Other Bennet Sister.
The BBC has cancelled The Other Bennet Sister after one series.
Jane Austen wrote a new novel about Mary Bennet.
The cast is moving production permanently from Wales to Canada.
tasks.correct_answer: New pictures and confirmed details preview a three-part Christmas special of The Other Bennet Sister.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה תמונות חדשות ופרטים מאושרים לקראת ספיישל חג מולד בן שלושה חלקים.

tasks.prompt: What happened to Mary Bennet in the first-series finale?
options: She left England to travel alone.
She agreed to marry Tom Hayward.
She refused to see her family again.
tasks.correct_answer: She agreed to marry Tom Hayward.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בסיום הסדרה מרי בנט, בגילומה של אלה ברוקולרי, הסכימה להינשא לטום הייוורד.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “an unexpected visitor from her past arrives at her door”, what does “unexpected” mean?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה unexpected פירושה דבר שלא ציפו לו או שלא תוכנן מראש.

tasks.prompt: Which statement about the Christmas special is correct?
options: It was filmed mainly in the United States.
It introduces Ruth Jones for the first time.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה יהיו שלושה פרקים נוספים, וכל אחד מהם יימשך 30 דקות.

tasks.prompt: Who joins the cast as Mary's housemaid Lucy?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נריס אמבר־סטוקס מצטרפת לצוות השחקנים בתפקיד לוסי, המשרתת של מרי.

tasks.prompt: What does “filming wrapped” mean in the article?
options: The sets were covered for winter.
The programme was hidden from viewers.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר של הפקה, filming wrapped פירושו שהצילומים הסתיימו.

tasks.prompt: Name two Welsh locations used for the first series and identify the company that produced the Christmas special.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני אתרי צילום מדויקים בוויילס ואת חברת ההפקה של הספיישל.
expected_points: Possible locations include Merthyr Mawr in Bridgend county, the Gower peninsula, and Brecon in Powys.
The Christmas special was produced by Cardiff-based Bad Wolf.

tasks.prompt: Why does the question “who will Mary become as Mrs Hayward?” suggest that marriage may create a challenge for Mary?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד נישואין יוצרים זהות ותפקיד חדשים למרי, תוך הסתמכות על הרמזים בכתבה.
expected_points: Mary is beginning a new chapter as Tom Hayward's wife.
The first series showed her facing social pressure in Regency England.
She may need to balance her own identity with expectations attached to being Mrs Hayward.
The unexpected visitor may test how she responds in her new role.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the confirmed information about the Christmas special in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מבנה הספיישל, מצבם של מרי וטום, לפחות פרט ליהוק אחד, ומידע על ההפקה או השידור.
expected_points: The special has three 30-minute episodes following Mary and Tom after their engagement.
Returning cast members include Ruth Jones, Tanya Reynolds and Laurie Davidson, while Nerys Amber-Stocks joins as Lucy.
An unexpected visitor from Mary's past will arrive seeking help.
Bad Wolf produced the special, filmed mainly in Wales, for BBC One and BBC iPlayer in the UK.

tasks.prompt: Write a short factual preview for a viewer deciding whether to watch the Christmas special.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב קדימון קצר ומושך המבוסס רק על עובדות מהכתבה, ללא המצאת עלילה.
expected_points: Mention that it is a three-part Christmas special based on Janice Hadlow's storylines.
Refer to Mary and Tom's new married chapter.
Mention the unexpected visitor or a confirmed returning/new cast member.
Use clear, inviting language without inventing events.
